# Reports and investigations

Follow `SKILL.md`: keep the topic brief current instead of creating a summary
item. File a risk, result or owner choice once; put routine checks together in
one checklist or table, with long logs in a named file link.

Use `question` for the title, `outcome` for the bottom line and owner impact,
and `why` for details. A result worth discussing separately is its own item;
otherwise add it to the existing point. Running findings use `ack_to: "open"`;
finished checks use `ack_to: "done"`; ruled-out leads use `ack_to: "dropped"`.

## Example

The owner can read the result while the remaining investigation continues.
Use the topic UUID and revision from `ariadne read`.
